answer: Sequential artifact challenge. Each identity must forge a unique solution to a compute puzzle seeded by the prior epoch's winners, published at dawn. Solutions are verified and only one submission per seed is accepted. A plume of derived metadata (timing, partial traces) is logged and cross-checked, so cloning requires independently solving every prior round's puzzle. Attacker cost: one full solve per identity per epoch, and any copied trace is rejected, so parallel sybils pay linear compute while honest identities amortize across time.
